CLI-only scans completed before handoff, so the recorded source-read and engine results remain scoped historical observations, not measurements of the repaired harness. The final aggregate verifier did not include a cold condition; its non-update endpoints remain historical, not new-state proof.

SP-R1-F2.not_reused: All historical native update_latest durations include the previous frame's synchronous OCR and are excluded from OCR-free update comparisons, including 25773257782 and 25474320866 ns in native_final_aggregate_verifier.

SP-R1-F3.correction: native_final_aggregate_verifier.identity.click_stimulus describes performClick incorrectly. The hash-bound verifier posted App-local leftMouseDown/leftMouseUp at the status button; activation followed initial routing. This was not global physical input.
